_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes#0, dune::mixed_methods#2 and dune::mixed_methods#4 — one fixture because all three are properties of the same two composite spaces and no weak form is built, so nothing JIT-compiles (wall time 8 s, 2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured: hasattr(dune.fem.space,'product_space') is False and importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError, while product() and composite() over (lagrange(order=2,dimRange=2), lagrange(order=1)) both give dimRange 3 and size 187 — the same object for the same arguments. ufl.TrialFunctions(W) returns a 1-TUPLE whose single entry has shape (3,); the 1-tuple UNPACKS without error, which is why the mistake is silent, and the dolfinx two-name idiom fails with ValueError 'not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 1)' — a message about counts, not about spaces. The documented workaround was executed: TrialFunction(W) sliced as as_vector([t[0], t[1]]) / t[2] gives shapes (2,) and ().
